name: Former smoker
formula_note: 1 if the user used to smoke but has quit; never-smoker = reference

name: Current smoker
formula_note: 1 if the user currently smokes; never-smoker = reference

name: Cigarettes per day
citation: Mortality in relation to smoking: 50 years' observations on male British doctors
formula_note: current smokers' cigarettes per day, z-scored; 0 for never/former. An unstated dose is scored at the cohort's smoker mean, not at zero.

name: Physical activity
formula_note: z(ln(MET-min/week + 1)); MET-min = 4.0 x minutes x days (IPAQ, RES-03); age-interacted

name: Long sleep
formula_note: 1 if habitual sleep >= 8.5 h (short-sleep flag dropped, EXP-12)

name: Waist circumference
formula_note: z(waist_cm), sex-specific; What-If uses waist's total effect (EXP-12)

name: Diabetes
formula_note: 1 if a doctor has diagnosed diabetes

name: High blood pressure
formula_note: 1 if a doctor has diagnosed hypertension

name: Chronic respiratory disease
formula_note: 1 if COPD, chronic bronchitis, or emphysema

name: Mobility limitation
formula_note: any difficulty walking or climbing stairs (some and a lot are scored the same; ordinal refit pending)

name: Cardiovascular history
formula_note: 1 if prior heart attack, stroke, or heart failure

name: Diet quality
formula_note: z(Mediterranean-style score 0-5) from the five diet items (RES-03)

name: Sedentary time
formula_note: z(sitting/screen hours per day); modelled jointly with activity

name: Alcohol
formula_note: categorical none(ref)/light/moderate/heavy, coefficients constrained >= 0; no protective dip (RES-02)

name: Environment
formula_note: ln(1.095)*(PM2.5-ref)/10 + ln(0.965)*(NDVI-ref)/0.1; context for the personal clock, lever in 'Where Should I Live?'
